reason: My paper diary and my head already work, I know every customer and what they owe. Orders already come on WhatsApp and I handle them fine, so I do not feel a problem big enough to change how I do things.
objection: My udhaar khata is my most important thing. Why would I hand it to some unknown company's assistant, and what if it picks up an order wrong or the khata goes wrong and a customer argues with me?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on a neighbouring kirana owner I know, for a few weeks, with his khata correct, and the paper diary kept running alongside so I lose nothing if it fails.
